Name: PERSONAL_SCENARIO_PARAM_ST
Description: Each hero's personal story objectives. The next objective is the first row whose objective flag is still off; some are also shown on the matchmaking screen.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 1 on row 1000 (Wylder: Chapter 1) only.

Fields.Name: Scenario Objective ID
Fields.Description: Text ID of the objective shown for this story step (in the story list and, for the hero's next unfinished step, on the matchmaking screen). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Objective Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that marks this step as done: the game shows the objective of the hero's first row whose flag is off. 0: the row is skipped.

Fields.Name: Scenario Title ID
Fields.Description: Title text of this story entry in the story list. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Scenario Body ID
Fields.Description: No reader found; by its name, the body text of this story entry. -1: none. Retail: set on 85 of 229 rows (101000…).

Fields.Name: Scenario Image ID
Fields.Description: Image shown with this story entry in the story list. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Hero ID
Fields.Description: The Nightfarer (HeroParam row) this story step belongs to.

Fields.Name: Show on Matchmaking Screen
Fields.Description: Set: while this is the hero's next objective, it is shown on the expedition matchmaking screen. Clear: nothing is shown there. Retail: set on the "Find ... in Limveld" objectives.

Fields.Name: Unknown Flag
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: set exactly on the rows that have a Flashback Flag ID.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Flashback Flag
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: an event flag on 170 of 229 rows (e.g. 1029880), 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Spawn Point Entity ID
Fields.Description: No reader found; by its name, the entity ID of the point the player starts at. Retail: 10004000 on 191 of 229 rows, a few other 1000xxxx points elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Unknown

Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 0 except 10001961 (an event flag also used by Scenario Placement rows) on row 7052 (Guardian: Chapter 6).
